![Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_header.webp) **本资源包旨在改善附魔书的外观，现在每一本都将独一无二！** 社区曾无数次向创作者提出这一请求，以便玩家们能够轻松区分不同的附魔书。为此，我们精心打造了这款出色的资源包，为每本书提供了与其主题相匹配的独特纹理。 我们还兼容了超过 84 个模组，包括：
展开列表 Ad Astra: Giselle Addon, Additional Additions, Additional Enchanted Miner, Alex's Caves, Alex's Caves: Stuff & Torpedoes, Alex's Mobs, Alexs Caves Exemplified, Allurement, Apotheosis, Apothic Enchanting, Apothic Spawners, Ars Additions, Ars Elemental, Ars Nouveau, Arthropofia, AzureLib, Backpacked, Better Archeology, Better End, BetterNether, Biome Makeover, Box of Horros, Celestisynth, Clutter, CoFH Core, Combat Roll, Corail Tombstone, Create, Create Stuff & Additions, Darker Depths, Death Knights, Deep Aether, Deeper and Darker, Draconic Evolution, EnderIO, Ensorcellation, Eternal Starlight, EvilCraft, Farmer's Delight, Fins and Tails, Forbidden Arcanus, Galosphere, gofish, Golden Foods, Hunter's Return, Jaden's Nether Expansion, Just a lot more enchantments, Just Enough Guns, Kobolds, Malum, Midnight, MineColonies, My Nether Delight, Mystical Agriculture, Mythic Charms, MythicBotania, Nature's Aura, Nether Depths Upgrade, Opposint Forge, Piglin Proliferation, Railcraft Reborn, Reliquary Reincarnations, Species, Spawner+, Spell Engine, Spell Power Attribute, Stalwart Dungeons, Stellarity, Supplementaries, Terramity, The Bumblezone, The Deep Void, The End of Herobrine, The Twilight Forest, The Undergarden, The Undead Revamp, Things, Too Many Bows, Trials Chambers, Unusual Fish, UtilitiX, Vampirism, Vein Mining, When Dungeons Arise and You're in Grave Danger and Yomai Style.
需要 **[CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)** 或 **[Forge CIT](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forge-cit)**（也支持 OptiFine）。 这些纹理的设计师是 Arkadya。 ### 需要服务器和朋友一起玩吗？

寻找卓越的服务器托管服务？首选 **[BisectHosting](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)**。当然，您可以安装任何您想要的模组或整合包，他们的客服团队随时为您提供帮助。 **[使用优惠码 "Lupin" 可享 25% 折扣！点击此处！](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)** ![Summary](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_summary.webp) Beautiful Enchanted Books 的目标很简单，那就是为所有 Minecraft 附魔书带来焕然一新的外观——它们将不再千篇一律、枯燥乏味！ 此外，它们的色调将根据主题或用途保持一致，同时当然还具备独特的设计元素，使其在同类中脱颖而出。我们确信您一定会爱上这些设计！ ![FAQ](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_FAQ.webp) ### 它能在服务器上运行吗？ ### 当然可以！请记住，与好友一起游玩模组服务器的最佳选择是 BisectHosting，通过 **[点击此链接即可享受 25% 的折扣](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)**。 ### 此资源包可以用于整合包中吗？ ### 当然可以！前提是仅限发布在 Modrinth 或 CurseForge 平台上。上传至任何其他平台都将侵犯我们的版权，且绝对不允许。 不过，如果您考虑将其添加至您的 Modrinth 或 CurseForge 整合包中，我们将不胜感激。如需任何微调或有其他疑问，请随时联系我们！ ![Screenshots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VDTtLGSV/images/d34c7c7910e2acf5a583daedcf9bb9439ef813aa.jpeg) [![DISCORD](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MultiRecipe/BH_Lupin_Discord.webp)](https://discord.gg/X8VY5WMbe4) .
